questions.question: What are the three phases of this Python course?
options: Python Basics and lots of different games
questions.explanation: The course is structured into Phase 1 (Fundamentals), Phase 2 (Intermediate), and Phase 3 (Advanced Applications) to guide you from beginner to advanced level.

questions.question: What can you do on this learning platform?
options: Only read lessons and watch videos
Write, run, and test Python code in your browser
Download JavaScript programs to run on your computer
questions.explanation: This is an interactive platform where you can write Python code directly in your browser, run it instantly, and get immediate feedback on your solutions.

questions.question: What will you earn as you progress through the course?
options: Only a certificate at the end
XP points and badges for completing lessons
questions.explanation: The platform uses gamification to motivate learning. You'll earn XP (experience points) for completing lessons and unlock badges for achievements.
